bootstrap.limitations: Only seven rounds; temporal dependence and desktop interference are uncontrolled.

provenance_note: Input hashes identify the original local input files; published inputs replace absolute corpus paths with filenames. Binary hashes distinguish the matrix/pilots from the balanced builds and quality runs.

results.timing_scope: scratch + pack + seed + distance/selection + ordered f64 sums + center updates; diagnostics excluded

quality_protocol.purpose: Validate numerical candidates against full-query baseline quality and logical scan work
quality_protocol.reason: Each candidate processes every query once. A different warmup count does not alter deterministic result IDs or logical scan counts, but these runs do not support search-latency comparisons. Batched4 and Batched8 produced the same full index fingerprint in the pilot; the batched family is tested with Batched4.
